headword: {懐中時計|かいちゅうどけい}

definitions.explanation: A small portable timepiece carried in a pocket, typically on a chain.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}の{懐中時計|かいちゅうどけい}をもらった。
examples.english: I received my grandfather's pocket watch.

examples.japanese: {金|きん}の{懐中時計|かいちゅうどけい}を{持|も}っている。
examples.english: I have a gold pocket watch.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はポケットから{懐中時計|かいちゅうどけい}を{取|と}り{出|だ}して{時間|じかん}を{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: He took out a pocket watch from his pocket and checked the time.

notes:
A small clock carried in a pocket, typically attached to a chain. A compound of {懐中|かいちゅう} (in one's pocket; on one's person) and {時計|どけい} (clock/watch). Although no longer a common everyday item, pocket watches appear frequently in literature, period dramas, and as collector's items.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {懐中時計|かいちゅうどけい}の{鎖|くさり}: pocket watch chain
- {懐中時計|かいちゅうどけい}を{開|ひら}く: to open a pocket watch
- {金|きん}の{懐中時計|かいちゅうどけい}: a gold pocket watch
- アンティークの{懐中時計|かいちゅうどけい}: an antique pocket watch

RELATED WORDS:
- {腕時計|うでどけい}: wristwatch
- {懐中|かいちゅう}{電灯|でんとう}: flashlight (another {懐中|かいちゅう} compound)
- {時計|とけい}: clock; watch
